jobs.title: Technical Product Owner (m/f/d)
jobs.description:
About us

Since 2000, has been making shipping simpler, more transparent, and more efficient for businesses. With our platforms and , companies can quickly compare and directly book their daily shipping needs. By bringing together a wide range of carriers on our platforms, we combine modern technology with personal service.

Across several locations in Europe, our teams work every day to simplify shipping processes in a sustainable way. We believe in open collaboration and fast decision-making. That’s why we are looking for people who take ownership, contribute ideas, and want to actively shape the future with us.

Your mission

As our (Technical) Product Owner (m/f/d), you will be part of our Product Team and take ownership of key technical interfaces and integrations across our platforms. Your main focus will be on our Customer APIs, the Unified Carrier Interface (UCI), and, going forward, the Unified Financial Platform (UFP) as well as our HubSpot integration.

You will work at the intersection of Product, Engineering, and Business. You understand technical dependencies, translate different requirements into clear priorities, and work closely with our teams to ensure that our integrations are reliable and continuously evolving.

You will collaborate closely with our Product Owners, Technical Business Analyst, Software Engineers, and Data Insights team while also acting as an important point of contact for internal stakeholders, customers, carriers, and external partners.

Your Key Responsibilities

  • You own and continuously develop the roadmap for our Customer APIs across LMS Enterprise and LMS Next.
  • You drive the migration of our API customers from LMS Enterprise to LMS Next, identifying and prioritizing the features and carrier integrations required to make the transition successful.
  • You act as a technical point of contact for our API customers, supporting them with questions, troubleshooting, and technical challenges.
  • You take ownership of the development of our Unified Carrier Interface (UCI) in close collaboration with internal and external stakeholders.
  • You analyze requirements for carrier features and services, translate them into clear requirements for Engineering, and support QA in defining relevant test cases.
  • You communicate directly with our carriers to clarify technical requirements and integration specifics.
  • Once live, you take ownership of our Unified Financial Platform (UFP) and manage its backlog, requirements, and further development.
  • You continuously monitor our existing HubSpot integration and prioritize adjustments based on evolving business needs and feedback.
  • Across all these areas, you connect Engineering, business stakeholders, carriers, and external partners, ensuring clear requirements, priorities, and decisions.

What you need to succeed

  • You have a technical background, for example in Software Engineering or Computer Science, or several years of experience working at the intersection of Product and Engineering.
  • You have experience as a Product Owner or Product Manager, ideally working with APIs, platforms, or technical integrations.
  • You have a solid understanding of APIs, API design, versioning, and migration strategies and feel confident engaging in detailed technical discussions with engineers.
  • You are able to understand complex technical topics and translate them clearly for different audiences.
  • You are confident in stakeholder management and know how to balance and prioritize competing technical and business needs.
  • You are comfortable managing multiple workstreams and adapting to changing priorities while keeping a clear overview of what matters most.
  • You enjoy working collaboratively across teams and locations, including with colleagues in Hamburg and Naarden.
  • You are curious about AI tools and digital solutions and enjoy exploring new ways to improve productivity, processes, and workflows.
  • Experience in logistics, parcel, or freight tech, particularly with carrier API integrations, is a plus.
  • Familiarity with HubSpot or CRM integrations, as well as financial or invoicing systems and interfaces, is also a plus.

Why ITA Logistics Group?

You can expect a work environment where new ideas are genuinely welcomed and feedback is not just accepted, but actively encouraged. We challenge the status quo, embrace agile ways of working, and continuously evolve. This also means making use of modern digital tools and AI-driven solutions that support your day-to-day work and help make processes more efficient.

  • 30 days of vacation
  • Flexible working hours and hybrid work
  • Time tracking and overtime compensation
  • Subsidized HVV/Deutschlandticket or parking
  • SpenditCard with a monthly credit of €50
  • Company pension scheme
  • Corporate Benefits Program
  • Counseling and support services through the Fürstenberg Institute
  • Workation opportunities

Join the ITA Crew

You feel addressed and are interested in joining our team as Technical Product Owner in beautiful Hamburg?
Please apply stating your earliest possible starting date! Franziska Linge is looking forward to your application.

We welcome applications from people of all genders, backgrounds, ages, disabilities, sexual orientations, and religions.

Applicants with severe disabilities will be given preferential consideration if equally qualified.

jobs.title: Senior Construction Project Manager
jobs.description:
Elgin Values

Core behavioural responsibilities for all employees
 
Agility We Lead with Agility  Integrity We Act with IntegrityExcellence We Empower ExcellenceCareWe Value Care


Job Description

Are you an experienced construction project leader with the commercial acumen to deliver complex infrastructure projects while managing the expectations of lenders, investors and key stakeholders?

We are looking for an experienced Senior Construction Project Manager to fulfil the Client / Employer’s Representative role across Elgin’s utility-scale solar PV, BESS and co-located PV/BESS projects. The role is focused on leading multidisciplinary project teams within a single Elgin delivery framework, ensuring that finance, legal, engineering, procurement, construction, operations, route-to-market and external adviser inputs are coordinated into one clear project position from late stage development / FID through construction, commissioning, commercial operations and handover to Asset Management. Particular emphasis will be placed on lender, investor, SPV governance and internal delivery interfaces.
 
This role requires significant project and contract management experience, including direct involvement in project finance processes, lender due diligence, conditions precedent, drawdown evidence, lender reporting, waivers / consents and coordination with lender technical advisers. The successful candidate will need specific experience with FIDIC based Construction Contracts, strong commercial judgement, disciplined contract administration capability and the ability to translate project delivery status into clear funding, governance and decision-making outputs.
 
To be successful in the role, you will have experience representing a client, employer, sponsor or SPV in the delivery of complex infrastructure or renewable energy projects. You will be commercially astute, highly organised, confident leading multidisciplinary project teams through a common governance and delivery framework, and capable of engaging credibly with lenders, investors, advisers, contractors, shareholder forums and senior internal stakeholders.

What you will be do:

  • Fulfil the Client / Employer’s Representative role for allocated projects, ensuring Elgin’s SPV, governance, commercial and contractual obligations are actively managed from FID through COD and handover.
  • Lead project and contract management on project-financed assets, coordinating lender processes including conditions precedent, drawdown evidence, lender technical adviser queries, lender reporting, waivers / consents and funding milestone submissions.
  • Administer and manage high-value EPC, ICP and related project contracts, including notices, variations, claims, payment applications, completion milestones, liquidated damages, defects and close-out obligations.
  • Maintain disciplined project controls across programme, budget, cash flow, risk, actions, decisions and change, ensuring transparent reporting to senior management, SPV governance bodies, lenders and investors.
  • Act as the primary project coordination point between Elgin’s internal project team, finance, legal, procurement, engineering, construction, operations, route-to-market and external advisers, ensuring that all workstreams operate from one integrated delivery plan, one risk position and one set of decision requirements.
  • Lead and manage multidisciplinary internal project teams within Elgin’s agreed delivery framework by setting priorities, clarifying accountabilities, managing dependencies, aligning workstreams to project milestones and escalating decisions in a timely and structured manner.
  • Manage the relationship and reporting cadence with project finance lenders, equity investors, shareholder representatives, lender technical advisers and other key finance-facing stakeholders, including preparing and presenting clear, decision-ready updates for shareholder forums and related governance meetings.
  • Oversee contractor, owner’s engineer and technical adviser interfaces to ensure delivery evidence, technical outputs and contractual positions support Elgin’s funding, governance and employer obligations.
  • Proactively identify commercial, contractual, programme and financing risks, develop mitigation plans and ensure issues are escalated with clear options, recommendations and decision requirements.
  • Support tendering, contract negotiation and commercial strategy by ensuring delivery arrangements are bankable, financeable, contractually robust and aligned with lender / investor expectations.


Your profile

What you will need: 

  • Degree in project management, construction management, engineering, or similar.
  • Extensive experience in infrastructure, renewables, power, energy storage or comparable capital projects, with significant project and contract management responsibility.
  • Direct experience working on project-financed projects, including lender due diligence, , funding drawdowns, lender technical adviser processes and ongoing lender / investor reporting.
  • Strong understanding of the Client / Employer’s Representative role and experience representing an owner, SPV, sponsor or employer in the delivery of complex contracted projects.
  • Extensive experience administering FIDIC, EPC, ICP and construction management contracts, including notices, variations, claims, payment mechanisms, completion tests, liquidated damages and contractual close-out.
  • Demonstrable ability to lead multidisciplinary internal teams and align finance, legal, engineering, procurement, construction, operations and external adviser inputs around delivery milestones within a standardised delivery framework.
  • Strong commercial and financial acumen, with the ability to assess risk versus reward, protect the employer’s position and communicate implications clearly to senior stakeholders.
  • Experience preparing and presenting concise, decision-ready reports for senior management, investment committees, SPV boards, lenders, investors, shareholder forums and other governance forums, with the ability to translate complex programme, commercial, technical and financing issues into clear options and recommendations.
  • Working knowledge of utility-scale solar PV, BESS, grid connection and route-to-market interfaces, with sufficient technical understanding to challenge contractors and advisers effectively.
  • Highly organised and proficient in Microsoft Office and project controls tools, with strong written communication, meeting management and stakeholder engagement skills.
  • Valid driver’s license for Ireland and the UK.

jobs.title: Technical Product Manager
jobs.description:
About BJAK

The original mission of BJAK is we believe people deserve smarter ways to plan, save and grow their money. This is the origin of our name.

 

Started in 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, its the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.

 

Today, we are expanding ways to help people in the region — this includes spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more. Our mission is help people get more from their money every day.

 

We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities from our offices and remotely, who truly enjoys their work. We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few.

 

If you're this person, we'd love to talk to you.

 

The Role

BJAK is building a Neobank Superapp for Southeast Asia. As a Technical Product Manager, you’ll own a product vertical end to end—such as payments and expense management, remittance, insurance, or wealth and trading—from strategy, outcomes, and roadmap through to the technical design and delivery of the systems behind it.

 

This is a product where real money moves, mistakes are immediately visible, and licensing, compliance, and third-party rails are core product constraints—not considerations around the edges.

 

We are AI-native by default, but AI is a means, not the goal. The bar is knowing where a model can genuinely improve an outcome, where deterministic systems must remain in control, and how to build products that are reliable, auditable, and trusted when money is involved.

 

What you'll be doing

  • Own a vertical end-to-end — outcomes and metrics, a backlog prioritised by value / risk / dependency / strategic priority, acceptance criteria crisp enough to build and test against.

  • Shape the technical design with engineering — system boundaries, money-movement correctness (idempotency, ledgering, reconciliation), third-party-rail reliance and rail-down behaviour, failure/retry/refund paths, security, latency, scalability, recovery.

  • Make hard trade-offs across correctness, speed, cost, reliability and UX — and defend them to an engineering, compliance or ops lead who pushes back.

  • Treat regulated constraints as first-class product inputs — licensing scope, CDD/KYC and limits, sanctions/PEP screening, transaction monitoring, data residency and privacy. Know which are hard launch gates and which are forward-readiness.

  • Apply AI where it earns its place — define what it's allowed to decide, where a human stays in the loop, how it's evaluated, and what it does when unsure. Every AI-surfaced number traces back to a real record.

  • Ship against external gates — build feature-complete behind flags; go live per rail as each partner and regulatory gate clears.

  • Work across Engineering, Design, Compliance, Operations, Treasury and Finance/Reconciliation.

     

What you'll need

  • Product leadership — significant experience owning a complex technical product end-to-end; strong judgement and decisiveness under ambiguity; ability to balance ambition against technical, regulatory and operational reality; can hold their own with senior engineers.

  • Technical foundation — solid system design (boundaries, datastores, queues/workflows, APIs, failure modes, consistency under concurrency); comfort reading, reviewing and challenging design docs; can sketch an architecture and a sequence. No production code, but technical enough that engineers don't have to simplify.

  • Domain — experience in a regulated / high-consequence domain (payments, banking, remittance, insurance, …) or demonstrable fast-ramp ability; understands why money movement is different (correctness over convenience, irreversible states, partners you don't control).

  • AI judgement — hands-on with LLM-based products; can frame a feature as eval-able (offline, online, human feedback); realistic on hallucination/drift/data gaps, including data-blocked vs model-blocked and when a model must not be in the loop at all.

  • Nice to have — engineer or highly-technical-PM background · zero-to-one · shipped AI-heavy consumer products · defined eval metrics for ML/LLM systems · AI UX + failure-handling intuition · SEA market experience.

     

Outcomes

  • Clear vertical strategy and legible roadmap

  • Ships fast and clears the gates that actually block launch

  • Money is correct and users are never misled about the state of their funds

  • AI features are valuable, predictable and trusted

  • Trade-offs made deliberately under uncertainty and hold up when challenged

  • Engineering, design, compliance, and operations are aligned with minimal friction

     

Location

This role is remote, but candidates must be based in Germany. We are hiring specifically for this market, so applicants should already be based in Germany.

 

Language

English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required.

 
 

Interview Process

Our process is designed to move fast:

1. Online assessment or practical task

2. Role-specific interview

3. CEO / final round

 

For strong candidates, we aim to complete the process and make an offer within 1 week from the start of the interview process. Candidates who complete assessments quickly will be prioritized.

jobs.description:
About the Role

We're a Series A AI-powered B2B SaaS company operating in the procurement intelligence and supply chain space, backed by top-tier European and global investors. Our ~150-person team is building the next generation of AI-agent-driven procurement tools for the industrial sector — and we're looking for a Junior Product Designer to help define what that looks like.

This is a rare opportunity to shape UX patterns that don't yet exist. You'll help invent how procurement professionals supervise and collaborate with AI agents, moving workflows away from traditional dashboards toward genuinely agentic systems. You'll join a small, cross-functional team shipping weekly to paying customers in a fast-moving, high-impact environment.

Location: On-site in Munich, Bavaria, Germany. Visa sponsorship is not available for this role.

What You'll Do

  • Design end-to-end product flows, screens, and prototypes that ship to customers within weeks — not quarters.

  • Define how AI agents surface work to users, how humans review and act on it, and how trust is established between people and automated systems.

  • Prototype rapidly in Figma, code, and with AI tools to communicate ideas quickly and clearly.

  • Collaborate closely with product managers, engineers, and domain experts to reduce handoff friction and maintain design quality through launch.

  • Review pull requests and make last-mile interaction and visual tweaks to ensure what ships matches the design intent.

  • Contribute to and raise the bar on the product design system — visual standards, component consistency, and interaction patterns.

  • Own features from discovery through launch, not just isolated screens.

  • Iterate rapidly based on real customer feedback and production usage data.

What We're Looking For

Required:

  • 0–2 years of product design experience (strong internships count) with a portfolio of shipped work — ideally in B2B, complex workflows, or data-heavy products.

  • Demonstrated experience contributing to and maintaining a design system with a focus on consistency across a product.

  • Daily use of AI tools in your design workflow (e.g., Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor, v0, Figma Make) for ideation, prototyping, or collaboration.

  • Proven ability to own the end-to-end design lifecycle — from discovery and problem framing through to launched, production-quality features.

  • Strong visual and interaction design instincts with an eye for system-level consistency.

  • Practical understanding of the design-to-development handoff and a track record of close cross-functional collaboration.

  • Comfort with ambiguity and a clear bias for shipping over endless polish.

Bonus points for:

  • Prototyping experience in code (HTML, CSS, React).

  • Experience designing for non-technical users navigating complex domains.

  • Considered opinions on how AI should appear and behave in products beyond a chat interface.

Location & Work Arrangement

This role is fully on-site in Munich, Germany. You must be available to work from our Munich office. Visa sponsorship is not available — candidates must have existing authorisation to work in Germany.

Equal Opportunity

We are an equal opportunity employer committed to fair employment regardless of race, religion, sexual orientation, age, marital status, disability, or gender identity.

jobs.title: Senior Frontend Engineer (Full-stack)
jobs.description:
Data quality is the bottleneck of the AI era. Every Fortune 500 is trying to solve it. We're the team they call.

Soda is the data quality layer for Disney, Ralph Lauren, CBRE, HelloFresh, 2K Games, and Nubank. Our open-source engine, Soda Core, is used by companies like Tesla, Slack, Adyen, Walmart, and JPMC. The category is growing fast because AI doesn't work on bad data, and we're hiring a Senior Full-Stack Engineer to build the platform that catches data problems before they become business problems.

About Us

Soda's mission is to monitor the world's decisions. We're building the first Data & AI performance monitoring platform that spans data collection to automated decision-making. Soda helps customers find, understand, and fix data quality issues by combining automated post-production monitoring with pre-production pipeline data testing.

Soda was founded in 2019 by Maarten (employee #5 at Collibra) and Tom (creator of multiple open-source projects generating hundreds of millions in value). We commercialize through Soda Cloud and we're well-funded, with investors like Point 9 Capital, Hummingbird, Singular, and Eurazeo.

The Role

You'll lead frontend work in one of our product teams: a TypeScript/Angular application with Storybook-driven components and Cypress e2e coverage, in front of a Java backend. You own the user experience end-to-end, from component architecture and state management down to the API shape, because the backend is yours to touch too. We're product engineers, not ticket-takers: you'll talk to users, shape the design with your PM, and ship without waiting for hand-offs.

Frontend is your craft; full-stack is your reach. You'll spend most of your time in the frontend, and you can ship a backend endpoint when the feature needs it rather than filing a ticket and waiting. We also build agentically: AI coding agents are part of the daily workflow here, not an experiment on the side.

What You'll Do

  • Own complex, data-dense UIs: dashboards, monitoring views, large tables, diffs and drill-downs that stay fast and legible.
  • Drive component architecture, state management, and frontend performance.
  • Build with a component library and Storybook; keep the design system coherent as the product grows.
  • Write tests at every layer. You'll help keep our Cypress e2e suite meaningful.
  • Build the frontend of agentic features: interfaces where users direct, review, and act on LLM-powered workflows.
  • Improve our systems for agentic development on the frontend: conventions, Storybook coverage, and tests that agents can build against reliably.
  • Shape the APIs you consume, and implement backend changes (Java) when your feature needs them.
  • Mentor backend-focused engineers on frontend, helping the team grow more full-stack and deliver features end to end.
  • Work directly with product, design, and customers to decide what to build. Your opinion matters here.

Hiring Process

  1. CV screen
  2. 20-minute phone screen
  3. First technical interview (45 min)
  4. Second technical interview (60 min)
  5. Culture fit (45 min)

We answer every application, and every candidate hears back within 3–5 days of each step. If it's not a hell yes, it's a no, and we'll tell you quickly and kindly.

Requirements

  • 5+ years building frontend for real products: complex single-page applications with real users, not just marketing sites.
  • Expert TypeScript and deep experience with a modern framework: Angular preferred (it's what powers Soda Cloud); strong React/Vue engineers willing to work in Angular are welcome.
  • Frontend craft: component architecture, state management, rendering performance, responsive design, and an eye for detail (you can spot a misaligned pixel).
  • Testing as a habit: you actually write tests, including e2e (Cypress/Playwright).
  • Working backend skills: you can read and modify a Java service, design an API from the consumer's perspective, and write competent SQL.
  • Systems insight: you understand how an API's shape drives round-trips, data flow, and perceived latency in the UI.
  • Agentic engineering: you ship production code with AI coding agents (Claude Code, Cursor, or similar) in the loop, and you know how to direct them well while keeping the quality bar high.
  • Independence: you don't need hand-holding in a distributed, async team across 12+ countries.
  • Fluent English.

Good to Have

  • Data-heavy or developer-tool products: data visualization, monitoring, analytics UIs.
  • Design-system or component-library ownership.
  • Multi-tenant SaaS at scale; high-growth startup experience.
  • Python: our data engineering stack runs on it.
  • Experience building agentic workflows into the product: LLM-powered features, tool-using agents, or AI-driven automation shipped to real users.
  • Data quality, data management, data observability, or ML monitoring industry experience.

Benefits

What We Offer

  • Compensation €85,000-120,000/year + equity.
  • Fully remote (EU-based), with a Belgian office available if you want one.
  • All the tokens you need, across all frontier models.
  • Real ownership, real impact, no micromanagement.
  • A team of senior engineers who ship, across 12+ countries.

Our Values

We value freedom with responsibility, transparency, and a growth mindset. We avoid politics, have no tolerance for dishonesty, and value open and direct communication without judgment. We proactively bring up and address potential issues before they become critical, and we overcommunicate frequently. Working at Soda, you will have full autonomy to make impactful product and roadmap decisions.

❤️ Why you will love to join Soda

  • Be part of a transformation: data quality is having its moment, and we're at the front of it.
  • Ownership from day one: if you see a bottleneck, you remove it.
  • International culture: colleagues in 12+ countries.
  • Work on your own terms: fully remote, flexible hours.

😡 What you might not love

  • Rapidly changing priorities: our roadmap can pivot quickly. It's a fast-paced environment with a LOT of work to be done.
  • Flexibility required: you will have to learn new things all the time.

jobs.title: Product Manager, Delivery Promise
jobs.description:
About Wolt

At Wolt, we create technology that brings joy, simplicity and earnings to the neighborhoods of the world. In 2014 we started with delivery of restaurant food. Now we're building the delivery of (almost) everything and you'll find us in over 500 cities in 30 countries around the world. In 2022 we joined forces with DoorDash and together we keep on dreaming big and expanding across the globe.

Working at Wolt isn't always easy, but it's definitely exciting. Here you'll learn more, build more, and ship more than in most other companies. You'll be challenged a lot, but also have a lot of fun on the way. So, if you're a self-starter with drive and entrepreneurial spirit, this could be the ride of your life.

We are looking for a Product Manager to join our Product Management organization, working with the Delivery Promise team. This is one of those parts of Wolt's business that people don't always realize the complexity of. Logistics is absolutely integral to Wolt, and doing it well can mean the difference between delivering blissful customer experiences efficiently and profitably vs. operational nightmares and a cacophony of late deliveries. 

The Delivery Promise team is in the Courier & Logistics Product group at Wolt. We're driving the future with estimates that fuel our growth, flywheel, shaping shopping decisions and streamlining deliveries. Our goal: boost Wolt's growth and profitability by delivering reliable, precise time estimates to customers and partners worldwide. In a nutshell, the team is responsible for crafting accurate and reliable time estimates that form a key part of the pre-checkout purchase experience for our consumers, right from discovery to checkout. We employ advanced machine learning models and innovative tools to craft delivery estimates experienced by consumers across all business lines for Wolt.   

As the Product Manager for the Delivery Promise team, your role will be integral in ensuring that we provide the best delivery estimates for our consumers while balancing the operational impact of fulfilling deliveries against the promised estimates. You will be contributing significantly to Wolt's goal of delightful customer experiences. 

Join us in shaping the future of delivery, where every delivery is an opportunity for delight and loyalty.

Our humble expectations

You could come to this role from various backgrounds, but ideally, you bring:

  • Plenty of previous experience as a Product Manager 
  • It's a plus for you if you have a background in Machine Learning or Data Science, since you would be focused on optimizing our estimates across markets and consumer cohorts.  
  • Proven track record in building products influencing cross-functional teams, including engineering, data, design, and operations.
  • High ownership and collaborative capabilities, making thoughtful decisions, and focusing on product details to ensure execution aligns with the vision.
  • Strong ability to define, execute, and measure meaningful OKRs, ensuring alignment with company-wide goals and fostering bottom-up alignment from your team.
  • Ability to focus on the bigger picture, creating solutions that benefit couriers, operations, and customer experiences across the organization.
  • Excellent stakeholder management skills, able to work effectively with diverse internal teams and external partners, while confidently engaging with leadership in a high-visibility role.

The position will be filled as soon as we find the right person, so make sure to apply as soon as you realize you really, really want to join us!

The compensation will be a negotiable combination of monthly pay and DoorDash RSUs. The latter makes it exceptionally easy to be excited about our company growing and doing well, as you'll own a piece of the pie.

Our Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion

We're committed to growing and empowering a more inclusive community within our company, industry, and cities. That's why we hire and cultivate diverse teams of people from all backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives. We believe that true innovation happens when everyone has room at the table and the tools, resources, and opportunity to excel.

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer (Kotlin,Java) (m/f/d)
jobs.description:
We're looking for a talented Senior Software Engineer with strong Kotlin skills (or Java and willing to learn Kotlin) to join us in Berlin or Munich.  

In the Foundation Division of FlixTech, our Finance Technology Stream helps the business grow efficiently by delivering smart, compliant, and automated finance solutions. We keep things simple for our internal users so they can spend less time on manual tasks and more time on what matters. The team you will join is not focused on user-facing experiences or polished UIs. Our success is measured by data correctness, consistency, and trustworthiness, even in complex and evolving business scenarios. You'll be part of a self-managed, cross-functional team with a Product Owner and fellow Software Engineers, directly supporting new country launches, new business models, and the continuous evolution of Flix's financial backbone. 

This role is well-suited for someone who enjoys ownership, working close to real business problems, and contributing to the long-term foundations of an international company. If you value collaboration, thoughtful engineering, and building systems that need to be right, not just fast, we'd love to meet you. 

About the Role

  • Design, develop, and maintain backend services using Kotlin 
  • Build and evolve scalable, event-driven systems that process, validate, and expose financial data 
  • Use AI tools such as Claude Code and Copilot conscientiously to assist in faster and higher-quality development
  • Collaborate closely with the Product Owner and Finance stakeholders to translate business requirements into robust technical solutions 
  • Ensure data accuracy, traceability, and auditability across financial and accounting flows 
  • Improve system reliability, observability, and performance for business-critical processes 
  • Contribute to clean code, architectural discussions, and continuous improvement of engineering practices 

About You

  • 5-7 years of experience developing backend systems, with Java or preferably using Kotlin
  • Hands-on experience building backend services using the Spring ecosystem (e.g. Spring Boot, Spring Data) 
  • Experience with event-driven design (e.g. asynchronous processing, messaging, domain events) 
  • Practical experience with cloud platforms (preferably AWS, or similar) 
  • Solid understanding of databases, both NoSQL (e.g. DynamoDB) and/or relational systems 
  • Comfortable working in complex, data-heavy domains (ideally Finance), where investigation, analysis, and precision are key 
  • Communicate clearly in English, open-minded, curious, and motivated to continuously improve both yourself and the systems you work on 

We recognize that everyone carries a unique set of valuable skills and experiences. If you think you could have an impact even though you don't meet 100% of the requirements, we still encourage you to apply. We want to hear from you!  

What We Offer

  • Travel perks: 12 free Flix vouchers + 12 discount vouchers for friends & family. 
  • Work from (M)Anywhere: Depending on your role, work from another location for up to 60 days per year. 
  • Hybrid work model: We are an office-first company, but we offer flexibility to balance work and life. 
  • Wellbeing support: Access confidential 1:1 counselling, courses, and stress management for yourself and up to four family members. 
  • Learning & Development: Take advantage of language classes, training courses, and expert-led sessions to grow your skills. 
  • Mentoring Program: Connect with experienced colleagues to gain insights and accelerate your career. 

To view more local benefits specific to each office location, please check out this link: Locations - Flix Career

Why Join Flix?

At Flix, you'll find teams that rally together to overcome challenges and spark creativity. We believe in ownership culture - giving you the freedom to take initiative, make an impact, and shape your own career path.
As we continue to expand across the globe, you can make a real difference in how we work.

If you're ready to grow and lead your journey, Flix is the place for you!

jobs.title: Account Executive (f/m/x)
jobs.description:
About lemon.markets 🍋

We enable anyone to be an investor. Our mission is to grow investing opportunities for all European customers and businesses. By empowering FinTechs, banks, and wealth managers to offer investment products, we help create financial well-being for their customers.

lemon.markets is a Brokerage-as-a-Service platform: simple digital access to capital markets through a single API. Our API-first infrastructure abstracts brokerage complexity with a well-documented API, a self-service customer operations portal, and a clear regulatory framework, so partners can launch customer-centric, compliant products in weeks, not months.

As part of the dwpbank group, we share a clear goal: we enable anyone to be an investor by making investing in capital markets more accessible. By combining dwpbank’s long-standing expertise and stability with lemon.markets’ technology-first mindset and speed, we are building a modern, modular securities services ecosystem. Together, we offer faster time-to-market, modular services, and a modern customer experience that helps financial service providers stay competitive and respond more flexibly in a changing market.

Your Mission:

Join lemon.markets at a pivotal growth moment and help scale the infrastructure powering investment products in Europe.

As we currently run two GTM motions, your focus will lie on our direct lemon.markets sales motion, owning the sales process end-to-end for key prospects: from targeting new accounts, to pitching our platform, leading deep qualification and solution discussions, and closing strategic partnerships across FinTechs, Banks, and Wealth Managers.

This is a highly hands-on role. You will work cross-functionally with Product, Partnerships, Engineering, Legal, and the broader Growth team to make a complex product tangible for prospects and to drive momentum across multi-stakeholder sales cycles.

Let’s be direct: they say you can’t get a great sales person who is highly ambitious for success, strategic, but also humble and a clever team-player at the same time. Challenge accepted?

You will:

  • Own the sales process end-to-end for key prospects, from prospecting and discovery to shaping, aligning, and closing commercial proposals.

  • Take full ownership of your accounts and proactively drive momentum across each stage of the sales cycle, with the persistence and creativity needed to move complex opportunities forward.

  • Build strong relationships with key champions, decision-makers, and ecosystem players, while involving internal experts from Product, Engineering, Partnerships, Legal, and Compliance at the right moments to support effective solution design.

  • Create and manage a healthy pipeline through targeted outbound prospecting, industry events, referrals, and strategic network-building across FinTechs, Banks, Wealth Managers, Insurers, and other relevant financial players.

  • Lead structured discovery and qualification processes, evaluate business cases, and help prospects identify the right commercial and operating model for their investment offering.

  • Continuously improve our sales processes, tooling, and ways of working to help build a scalable, efficient, and best-in-class sales setup.

You will be successful in this role if:

  • Expanding access to investing excites you. Our mission resonates with you, and you are motivated by helping bring modern investment products to market.

  • You bring B2B sales experience within the German and broader European market and have led full-cycle sales motions from prospecting, through commercial negotiations, to closing across segments such as Financial Service providers, Brokers and FinTechs.

  • You are a proactive builder of pipeline. You know how to source and develop opportunities, navigate industry events and networks, and combine research, outreach, and relationship-building to create momentum.

  • You are comfortable selling into complex and regulated environments. You can navigate multiple stakeholders, understand nuanced requirements, and translate technical or operational complexity into clear value for prospects.

  • You are adaptable in your approach. When something does not land, you reassess, refine, and try a different route rather than defaulting to a fixed playbook.

  • You communicate confidently with a broad range of stakeholders, including senior decision-makers, and are fluent in both German and English; additional European languages are a plus.

  • You bring ownership, curiosity, and a strong bias for action. You seek feedback, learn quickly, and enjoy working cross-functionally to build long-term partnerships.

How we take care of you:

  • 🚀 Compensation package: We offer you a competitive salary, based on your experience and the value-add you bring to lemon.markets.

  • 🕑 Flexible working hours: We trust people to choose when they work best and avoid a rigid 9 to 5 mindset. You decide on the rhythm that helps you do your best work, with only shared core hours from 12:00 to 16:00 to support collaboration.

  • 🏢 Hybrid work setup: You can work from anywhere in Germany within a hybrid model. At the same time, in-person collaboration is a key part of our culture. That being said, individual contributer lemoneers work 4 days or more per month on-site in our Berlin office, spending quality time together with the team at events, onsites/offsites or over team dinners.

  • 📈 Grow with us: We take your personal development seriously! You’ll get regular mentorship and stretch opportunities, a clear career development framework with frequent feedback conversations as well as an annual learning budget.

  • 🌱 People & culture: You’ll feel our culture in the small things, like polaroids from our lemoneers’ first day, Friday food market strolls at Maybachufer, and our monthly new-joiner breakfast. But also in the bigger things: celebrating the onboarding of new partners, growing our teams, and owning a strong discussion culture.

  • 💛 Perks & benefits: We choose benefits that add actual value. We sponsor a Deutschlandticket for employees on unlimited contracts, plus 50% off on Beatvest - our partner for financial education and investing.

  • 🏝 Workation: Get out of here! At lemon.markets you can work remotely from anywhere in the EU for up to 10 consecutive days at a time, and up to 60 days per year in total.

As an equal opportunity employer, lemon.markets is committed to building an inclusive workplace. The company welcomes people from all different backgrounds, including age, citizenship, ethnic and racial origins, gender identities, individuals with disabilities, marital status, religions and ideologies, and sexual orientations to apply.

If you feel this role could be a great match for you even if you don’t tick every box, we’d still love to hear from you, please apply.

jobs.description:
Headquartered in Tokyo, Japan, Evident employs around 4,500 people at a total of 57 locations worldwide. Evident Europe, headquartered in Hamburg, Germany, employs approximately 770 people in 16 countries. The product portfolio includes a wide range of microscope systems used in clinical diagnostics, medical and basic research, as well as in various industrial areas.

At Evident, we also deliver high-precision optical technologies—specifically industry-leading microscope objective lenses—integrated directly into high-tech instruments manufactured by third parties. Our OEM partners build cutting-edge solutions across life sciences, semiconductor manufacturing, space biology, and industrial instrumentation. Because of our superior optical quality, our partners choose to build with our components rather than manufacture their own.

Key Responsibilities

You bring strong role-related expertise and sharp thinking, and you’re motivated by our mission and operating principles. You move fast with good judgment, dig deep with curiosity, and make decisions from first principles, balancing speed and rigor.

About the team

The Regulatory & Compliance Division (RCD) at Airwallex is a collaborative group of legal, compliance and risk management experts. We're passionate about safeguarding Airwallex's operations, fostering a culture of compliance and ethical conduct, and ensuring we navigate the global financial landscape with integrity. We provide expert guidance and support to all areas of the business, proactively identifying, mitigating, and managing legal, compliance and financial risks.

The EMEA Regulatory Compliance Team forms part of the second line of defence (2LOD) at Airwallex whilst operating within the larger RCD function. We are a proactive and trusted business partner committed to enabling Airwallex’s growth and strategic goals by providing an advisory and oversight role. Our team culture is collaborative, impact-driven with a focus on continuous improvement. You’ll be part of a team that values transparency, empowerment, and high performance.

What you’ll do

As Senior Associate / Manager, Regulatory Compliance, UK, you will deliver on the regulatory engagement strategy for Airwallex in the UK. You will maintain our licensing responsibilities and coordinate with all internal and external parties as necessary to ensure compliance through the communication of regulatory requirements, cross-functional collaboration to productize solutions and offerings, implementation and execution of processes, accurate execution and filing of regulatory reports, renewal of registrations and licenses, end-to-end management of regulatory examinations, and interfacing with UK regulators (including the FCA) on ad-hoc inquiries. You will analyse new and existing products and provide guidance to ensure that our 2LOD controls are fit for purpose and comply with regulatory obligations, guide the first line business to enable the maturity of both customer-facing and internal back-office processes and product features.

Responsibilities:

  • Support the Airwallex Group’s expansion by managing the regulatory compliance components of licence authorisation processes

  • Act as a key stakeholder in relation to licence applications, business plan updates and information requests between Airwallex and our regulators

  • Ensure that our regulatory compliance and regulatory reporting obligations are maintained for all Airwallex Group entities in the UK

  • Support and / or manage on-site exams, inspections and audits (in collaboration with our RCD colleagues)

  • Advise the business with respect to regulatory change initiatives with a particular focus on how to effectively manage compliance risk attached to new and evolving UK laws and FCA rules

  • Develop policies, processes and provide advice in relation to regulatory risk obligations that exist within the 1st line business

  • Manage regulatory compliance risk within the Airwallex Risk Management Framework and associated escalation process (inc. governance forums and board reporting)

  • Advise the business in relation to conduct risk, Consumer Duty, complaints governance (including Financial Ombudsman Service escalations), and ethics matters relating to our financial services licences

  • Deliver the Compliance Monitoring Program through assisting with targeted and thematic reviews on a wide range of topics to ensure appropriate organisational maturity

  • Deliver the Airwallex Group’s Compliance Training for employees and conduct ad-hoc training to specific business areas as required

  • Conduct ‘Proactive Special Ops’ projects to unlock business or operational issues to enable Airwallex to achieve its strategic goals more rapidly

Who you are

We're looking for people who meet the minimum qualifications for this role. The preferred qualifications are great to have, but are not mandatory.

Minimum Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree with regulatory compliance experience in a financial institution, FinTech, legal / consulting firm, or combination of the above (minimum 4 years for Senior Associate; minimum 6 years for Manager)

  • Familiarity with financial regulatory laws, rules, regulations and industry best practices in the UK (specifically FCA-regulated environments)

  • Data proficiency - ability to work with data and leverage it for strategic decision-making

  • Ability to operate strategically and think creatively to solve complex regulatory compliance challenges

  • Superior communication skills, with the ability to clearly explain complex topics to a wide range of stakeholders including regulators, executive leadership, and front-line staff

  • Experience with developing and/or maintaining a compliance program within a financial institution, preferably in respect of payments and e-money activity

  • Exposure to licensing processes, regulatory reporting, regulatory expansion, and RegTech or technology-driven compliance solutions

  • Understanding of financial products and related conduct risk, ethics, and controls

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience dealing with the Financial Conduct Authority (FCA) and handling escalations to the Financial Ombudsman Service (FOS).

As the Cyber Security Engineering Business Manager (m/w/d) located in Germany, you drive commercial growth across NVISO's Cyber Security Engineering (CEN) practice globally, spanning both Security Operations Engineering (SOE) and Cyber Security Engineering (CSE) solution lines.

You are the commercial owner of both CEN solution lines: SOC and security operations professional services (SOE) and cloud security engagements (CSE). Your focus is turning first engagements into multi-year, cross-solution-line commitments rather than one-off wins.

Beyond accounts, you help shape the CEN service portfolio itself. The portfolio is under active development and needs commercial direction: what to productize, how to bundle, how to position against Microsoft's own stack. Typical responsibilities include:

  • Owning business development end-to-end for both CEN solution lines: SOC and security operations professional services (SOE) and cloud security engagements (CSE), including pipeline generation, qualification and conversion;
  • Owning the global Microsoft partnership: joint account planning, co-sell registration, and alignment with Microsoft's segment sellers across regions;
  • Pursuing relevant Microsoft specialization designations and managing funded engagement mechanics on behalf of NVISO;
  • Leading strategic accounts end-to-end, from initial engagement through multi-year expansion across solution lines;
  • Converting project work into recurring managed services as a deliberate commercial motion, not a coincidence of good delivery;
  • Shaping the CEN service portfolio in partnership with practice and delivery leadership, based on market signal and Microsoft's evolving stack;
  • Owning SOWs, RFP responses and complex tender processes across both SOE and CSE, including scoping, pricing, risk allocation and partner-program funding. You have a strong foundation of the service principles, and are able to work efficiently with in-house experts when needed;

  • Aligning cross-functionally with delivery, marketing, alliances and finance so commitments made to customers and to Microsoft are deliverable;
  • Coaching and mentoring consultants and managers involved in strategic pursuits, raising the commercial acumen across CEN;
  • Tracking market trends, competitor moves and Microsoft's roadmap, translating them into actionable commercial plays for the practice;
  • Bringing market intelligence back into the organization to influence what NVISO builds next in the CEN portfolio.

You are commercially driven, comfortable at CxO level, and equally at home in a Microsoft joint account planning session as in a customer boardroom. You treat partnership management as a discipline, not a byproduct of doing good work.

Requirements

  • You hold citizenship in one of the 32 NATO member states or the Austrian citizenship;
  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in a relevant field (business, engineering, information security, or equivalent professional experience);
  • A minimum of 10 years of experience in cyber security or adjacent technology consulting;
  • At least 5 years in business development, sales, alliance management or strategic account management within cyber security or IT services;
  • Demonstrable track record of closing multi-year engagements across both SOC professional services and cloud security, including hands-on ownership of SOWs, RFP responses and complex tenders;
  • Deep working knowledge of the Microsoft partner ecosystem: co-sell mechanics, specialization designations, MISA, partner incentive programs and funded engagements;
  • Practical understanding of Azure consumption dynamics and how they shape partner incentives and customer buying behaviour;
  • Established relationships within Microsoft's field sales organization, ideally spanning Benelux and DACH;
  • Strong grasp of the modern Microsoft security stack (Sentinel, Defender XDR, Purview, Entra) sufficient to shape commercial conversations with CISOs;
  • Experience contributing to service portfolio decisions rather than only selling what already exists;
  • Comfort operating in a matrixed environment where success depends on aligning delivery, marketing and alliance stakeholders;
  • Fluent business English; working proficiency in Dutch, French or German is a strong asset given the CEN geographical footprint.

Soft skills

  • Commercially opinionated, with the ability to take and defend a position under pressure from customers, partners and internal stakeholders;
  • Strong executive presence and credibility at CISO, CIO and Managing Partner level;
  • Genuine curiosity about the customer's business, not just their security posture;
  • Ability to hold two agendas at once: what is right for the customer, and what is right for NVISO's commercial position with Microsoft;
  • Discipline to convert conversations into pipeline, and pipeline into recurring revenue, rather than one-off wins;
  • Comfort with ambiguity, including operating on a service portfolio that is still forming;
  • Pragmatic and outcome-oriented, with a bias toward closing rather than deliberating;
  • Positive, team- and mission-oriented attitude aligned with NVISO's values (Proud, Break Barriers, Care, No BS).

Benefits

At NVISO, we care. We are committed to offering you a highly competitive remuneration package including financial and non-financial components:

  • Working and learning from the best people in the European cyber security industry. We have multiple SANS Instructors working at NVISO, our staff has presented at popular hacking conferences (BlackHat, BruCON, OWASP, etc) and all of our technical staff can acquire deep technical security certifications (GSE, GXPN, GREM, GCFA, OSCP, etc);

About the team

The Global Risk team at Airwallex plays a critical role in enabling the company’s growth by building a strong, scalable, and globally consistent approach to risk management. The team works across the business to define risk appetite, develop frameworks and policies, support strategic decision-making, and provide oversight of key risks as Airwallex expands across products, markets, and regulatory environments. You’ll be part of a highly collaborative group that partners closely with Product, Engineering, Operations, Commercial, Financial Crime Compliance, Regulatory Compliance, and Legal teams to help Airwallex grow responsibly and with confidence. This is a team where you’ll tackle complex, high-impact challenges, shape how risk is managed at a global fintech, and help build the foundations for long-term scale.

What you'll do

You will lead Airwallex’s global second line Financial Risk function, setting the guardrails that allow the business to scale safely across products, markets, and balance sheet activities. This is a senior leadership role for someone who brings deep technical judgment across credit, liquidity, capital, market, and model risk, and who has operated with real authority in a regulated financial institution. You will shape the global framework, challenge first line decisions, and advise senior leadership on the most material financial risk issues facing the company.

This role is based in the US or EMEA.

Responsibilities:

  • Establish and lead Airwallex’s global Financial Risk framework across credit, liquidity, capital, market, and model risk, including the standards, policies, limits, and escalation paths that support safe product and business growth.

  • Own second line credit risk oversight by defining global underwriting standards, credit limits, and governance, reviewing and challenging first line lending policies, and deciding on complex or escalated credit exposures and exceptions.

  • Direct the firm’s liquidity, funding, and capital resilience agenda by overseeing intraday and structural liquidity risk, maintaining contingency funding readiness, designing stress testing scenarios, and supporting internal adequacy assessments and high-stakes regulatory submissions.

  • Set and enforce global FX and market risk guardrails, and partner closely with Finance and Treasury leaders on exposure management and hedging strategy.

  • Build and institutionalize model governance and independent validation across risk, pricing, forecasting, and automated decisioning models, ensuring strong inventory management, validation standards, and regulator-ready governance.

  • Lead and grow a high-performing Financial Risk team spanning Liquidity & Market Risk, Capital Risk & Stress Testing, Model Governance & Validation, and Lending, Acquiring & Counterparty oversight, while acting as a visible and trusted advisor to senior management, committees, boards, and regulators.

Who you are

  • You have deep expertise across several core financial risk disciplines, including credit risk, liquidity risk, capital adequacy, stress testing, FX or market risk, treasury risk, or model risk management.

  • You have strong second line experience designing frameworks, setting limits, challenging first line decisions, and escalating material matters to senior governance forums and executives.

  • You have direct experience developing or overseeing capital and liquidity adequacy frameworks such as ICAAP, ILAAP, or equivalent prudential processes, and designing or governing enterprise stress testing programs.

  • You have experience building or scaling model governance standards, validation processes, and model inventory governance in a regulated environment.

  • You have a bachelor’s degree in finance, economics, mathematics, statistics, engineering, actuarial science, or another quantitative discipline.

Preferred qualifications:

  • You have experience leading financial risk in a global fintech, payments company, digital bank, or other high-growth platform business.

  • You have experience managing real-time liquidity, prefunding, cross-border payment rails, correspondent structures, or payment ecosystem risk.

  • You have familiarity with major prudential and model governance expectations, including Basel-related capital and liquidity frameworks and regulatory model risk standards.

jobs.title: Direct Contractor Tunisia & Morocco
jobs.description:
Why loveholidays?

At loveholidays - we trailblaze together. We're holiday devotees on a mission to become the world's most-loved holiday brand. We love your holiday as much as you do, and we're transforming the everyday through the power of loveholidays - bringing that holiday joy to millions. Our team is the driving force behind our challenger brand journey, operating with playful, devoted and joyful energy as we compete against bigger competitors through creativity, cultural connection and outsized ambition.

We’re using progressive tech to drive cutting-edge innovation and open the world to everyone. Within our Supply team, you'll find a place to accelerate your growth by actively seeking learning opportunities and carving your own path. You'll create impact for our future by owning projects and shaping the business strategy to reach shared goals, all within our enhanced international community of collaborative and passionate teams.


About the team

The Land Supply team is a central driver of loveholidays’ success. We are responsible for sourcing all of the bookable land products in our marketplace. Our mission is to secure the broadest range of inventory at the most competitive rates, availability & customer experience quality. We bridge the gap between data-driven yield management and long-term relationship building. As we grow towards our vision of becoming the global leader in package holidays, we are scaling directly contracted inventory and this team is leading that evolution.

 

The impact you’ll have

In this role, you will primarily lead our direct contracting activity across Tunisia & Morocco, with the opportunity to expand into other geographies over time. You will play a critical role not just in direct contracting with hoteliers on behalf of loveholidays, but will contribute strongly to the design of a best-in-class sourcing strategy for our future growth.

Ideally, you will be based within your designated region with strong local market connections. You will be our primary regional presence, leveraging your industry relationships to ensure loveholidays is a preferred partner for major hotel chains and DMCs. You will turn market insights into a sustainable commercial advantage, ensuring our diverse, international customer base always has access to the best rates and exclusive offers.

Your day-to-day:

  • Strategic Portfolio Growth: Define and implement the sourcing strategy, establishing loveholidays as a leader through a direct-contracting model.

  • Relationship Management: Serve as the lead contact for major hotel chains and DMCs, fostering long-term, mutually beneficial partnerships.

  • Commercial Negotiation: Secure market-leading rates, availability and exclusive value-adds that distinguish our brand in all markets - with a particular focus on UK + DE customers.

  • Market Agility: Proactively secure inventory and special offers during peak seasons to ensure we remain the first choice for customers throughout the year.

  • Cross-Functional Partnership: Partner with Inventory, Yield, and Marketing teams to ensure our supply aligns with demand and our top deals receive high visibility on our platform.

  • Operational Excellence: Manage the end-to-end contracting process, ensuring all agreements are finalized and loaded efficiently.

  • Market Analysis: Maintain a constant pulse on the industry to ensure our pricing and product offering remain highly competitive.

Your skillset:

  • Commercial Expert: You have a strong track record in purchasing within the destination and a deep understanding of commercial performance.

  • Strong Industry Network: You possess an extensive list of established contacts across hotel chains and DMCs in your destination.

  • Linguistic Fluency: You are professionally fluent in English and ideally French, capable of leading complex discussions in both languages.

  • Technical Proficiency: You have hands-on experience with the Channel Managers commonly used in North Africa

  • Adaptable & Driven: You work well in fast-paced environments and are motivated by achieving ambitious growth targets.

Desirable

  • Experience in a high-growth travel or OTA environment.

The interview journey:

  • Intro to loveholidays with the Talent Acquisition Team – 30 mins

  • 1st stage with the Contracting Team – 45 mins

  • 2nd stage Meet with Commercial Supply Director - 60 mins

  • Final stage with CMO or VP Land – 45 mins

Qualifikation

  • Erste belastbare Erfahrungen und Skills im Social-Media-Marketing sowie eine grundsätzliche Affinität zu Online-Marketing, idealerweise mit Vorliebe für B2B- & Content-Marketing (auf LinkedIn)

  • Eine eigenständige, proaktive Arbeitsweise – Du bringst Dich gerne mit eigenen Ideen ein und arbeitest genauso gerne im Team

Benefits

Kurz gesagt: ein performantes, geradlinig geführtes Unternehmen mit enormem Lerneffekt – für alle, die in einem hochprofessionellen, technisch exzellenten Umfeld früh Verantwortung übernehmen wollen.

Wir laden Sie ein, diesen Wandel gemeinsam mit uns voranzutreiben, indem wir kluge Köpfe mit einer gemeinsamen Vision zusammenbringen. Gemeinsam haben wir die Kraft, das Paradigma zu verändern, wie die Welt vernetzt ist.

Unsere Technology:

Die steigenden Anforderungen der Halbleiterindustrie an leistungsfähigere Chips mit höherer Bandbreite und geringerem Energieverbrauch werden durch unsere Technologie adressiert. Wir ermöglichen die Verbindung von Chips mit Hochdurchsatz-Computernetzwerken bei minimaler Latenz.

Der entscheidende Faktor ist die Nutzung der einzigartigen physikalischen Eigenschaften von Graphen, um elektronische Datenverarbeitung mit photonischer Kommunikation zu vereinen. Dadurch können unzählige Chips miteinander interagieren, als wären sie ein einziges System. Unsere Graphen-Photonik-Innovation hebt Rechenleistung und Effizienz auf ein neues Niveau.

Kurz gesagt: Wir vernetzen Chips zu leistungsstarken, energieeffizienten Systemen und überwinden mit unserer Graphen-Technologie die bisherigen Grenzen der Konnektivität in der Halbleiterindustrie.

jobs.title: Strategic Supply Partnerships Lead (REMOTE)
jobs.description:
REPLUG is a Mobile Revenue Growth partner that helps companies turn mobile into a measurable driver of revenue, customer value, and long-term business growth.

Rather than treating acquisition, retention, measurement and app experience as separate disciplines, we help businesses connect them into a unified growth system that improves commercial performance.

From global app publishers to established brands looking to unlock more value from mobile, we partner with companies that want to grow more efficiently, reduce dependency on saturated acquisition channels and build sustainable growth.

Our work combines strategic thinking with hands-on execution across App Store Optimization, Paid User Acquisition, CRM, measurement and mobile growth consulting.

We're now looking for a Strategic Supply Partnership Lead to grow our performance ads business globally.

Tasks

We’re looking for a Strategic Partnerships Lead to own and develop REPLUG’s performance supply ecosystem.

This is not a traditional account management role, and we are not looking for someone whose experience is limited to managing an existing book of supply partners.

We want someone with a genuine hunter mentality.

You should have a proven track record of identifying, approaching, and onboarding new partners, opening doors through your own network, and creating new commercial opportunities from scratch.

Strong industry relationships matter in this role. We are looking for someone who already understands the key players across the mobile performance ecosystem, knows who is worth speaking to, and can use that network to accelerate REPLUG’s access to new supply.

Just as importantly, you should have strong market intelligence. You should know what is happening across the ecosystem, where new inventory is emerging, which partners are gaining traction, where quality is deteriorating, and where the next meaningful opportunities may come from.

You’ll be responsible for identifying the partners we should work with, building the commercial relationships behind them, negotiating the right conditions and ensuring that those partnerships translate into real growth opportunities for our clients and REPLUG.

You’ll operate at the intersection of partnerships, commercial strategy and performance operations.

Your ecosystem will span OEMs, DSPs, SDK networks, publishers, affiliate partners and other alternative acquisition channels.

You’ll work closely with our performance, operations and sales teams to ensure we have the right supply available to support client growth.

You will report directly to the Performance Ads Lead, while working alongside the founders.

What You’ll Be Responsible For

Build and Grow Our Supply Ecosystem

You’ll continuously develop the network of partners that powers REPLUG’s alternative acquisition offering.

You will:

  • Identify and evaluate new publishers, networks and inventory partners globally.
  • Develop relationships with OEMs, DSPs, SDK networks, affiliates and other performance partners.
  • Own partner onboarding from initial evaluation through activation.
  • Identify gaps in our current supply and proactively develop new opportunities.
  • Build a diversified ecosystem that allows us to scale without becoming overly dependent on individual partners.

Our goal is to build the right ecosystem to scale brands globally.

Own Commercial Partnerships

You’ll manage our supply relationships as commercial partnerships, not simply operational integrations.

This includes:

  • Managing and developing existing partner relationships.
  • Negotiating payouts, pricing models and commercial terms.
  • Identifying opportunities to improve margins and scalability.
  • Exploring exclusive opportunities, preferred access or new inventory.
  • Holding partners accountable for agreed performance, quality and delivery.
  • Understanding when a partnership should be scaled, renegotiated or stopped.

You should be comfortable protecting REPLUG’s commercial interests while maintaining strong long-term relationships.

Connect Supply With Performance

Supply has value only when it delivers results.

You’ll work closely with our internal teams to:

  • Match client campaigns with the most relevant inventory and partners.
  • Support campaign launches and supply activation.
  • Identify new scaling opportunities based on campaign performance.
  • Analyse partner performance across quality, delivery, scalability and economics.
  • Identify supply-side issues that may be limiting campaign performance.
  • Help teams diversify acquisition when existing channels begin to saturate.

You’ll need to understand both sides of the equation: what advertisers need and what partners can realistically deliver.

Protect Quality

Scaling poor-quality inventory isn’t growth.

You’ll help ensure that REPLUG’s supply ecosystem maintains a high standard of performance and transparency.

You’ll monitor and challenge partners around:

  • Traffic quality.
  • Fraud and suspicious activity.
  • Attribution anomalies.
  • Delivery consistency.
  • KPI performance.
  • Scalability.
  • Communication and operational reliability.

When something doesn’t make sense, we expect you to investigate it rather than accept the explanation you’re given.

Help Build REPLUG’s Own Performance Infrastructure

The role also extends beyond third-party partnerships.

You’ll contribute to the development of REPLUG’s own performance ecosystem, including:

  • Managing and optimizing supply operations for our in-house rewarded app ecosystem.
  • Supporting the development of our internal affiliate and network marketplace infrastructure.
  • Identifying opportunities to build more direct supply relationships.
  • Helping define processes, systems and commercial frameworks that make the ecosystem scalable.

This gives you the opportunity to help build infrastructure rather than simply manage existing relationships.

Requirements

We’re looking for someone who understands that successful partnerships sit somewhere between relationships, numbers and execution.

You should have:

  • At least 3-5 years of experience within mobile advertising, AdTech, performance marketing, or affiliate marketing.
  • A solid understanding of the mobile performance ecosystem.
  • Experience working with publishers, networks, DSPs, OEMs, affiliates, SDK traffic or comparable acquisition partners.
  • Strong commercial instincts and confidence negotiating deals.
  • The ability to evaluate a partnership based on performance and business potential, not just relationship quality.
  • Strong analytical thinking and comfort working with performance data and KPIs.
  • Excellent communication and relationship-management skills.
  • The ability to manage multiple partners and initiatives simultaneously.
  • A proactive approach to identifying problems and opportunities.
  • Excellent spoken and written English.

Nice to Have

  • Existing relationships across the mobile advertising ecosystem.
  • Experience managing international publisher or supply partnerships.
  • Experience with rewarded acquisition or offerwall ecosystems.
  • Understanding of attribution, MMPs and mobile measurement.
  • Experience working with performance campaigns on CPI, CPA, ROAS or revenue-based models.
  • Previous experience within a mobile agency, ad network, DSP, affiliate network or app growth company.
  • Additional languages.

We’re looking for someone who:

  • Thinks commercially.
  • Is comfortable negotiating.
  • Follows through.
  • Makes decisions based on evidence.
  • Can operate independently.
  • Understands when to push and when a partnership simply isn’t worth pursuing.
  • Wants to build systems and relationships rather than inherit a static portfolio.

Benefits

Joining REPLUG means you'll have the opportunity to:

  • Lead the supply partnership strategy for ambitious mobile brands.
  • Work alongside mobile growth specialists, driving growth across the whole mobile ecosystem
  • Help shape one of the industry's emerging Mobile Revenue Growth consultancies.
  • Own and influence how we scale our performance ads business
  • Become one of the public faces of REPLUG through conferences, webinars and industry content.
  • Work remotely with flexibility and a high level of ownership.
  • Continue developing through learning, experimentation and industry events.
  • Access monthly health and fitness benefits
  • Access yearly educational budget

jobs.title: Laboratory Technician / Operator BTA/CTA – Protein Analytics (all genders)
jobs.description:
Role Overview

Help us ensure the quality and reliability behind every protein we bring to life.

As our Laboratory Technician - Protein Analytics, you'll be the hands-on backbone of our analytical lab, running the routine testing that tells us exactly what's happening inside our fermentation-derived proteins. From HPLC-UV runs to sample prep for proteomics and protein assays, your careful, well-documented work gives our scientists the data they need to keep pushing our precision fermentation platform forward.


Location: Frankfurt am Main

.

About Formo

At Formo, we’re rebuilding dairy to help create a just and resilient food system. 

Using precision fermentation, we produce real, bio-identical milk proteins, starting with casein, without the need for animals.

As a B2B ingredient company, we partner with leading food manufacturers to bring next-generation dairy products to market. We focus on developing and scaling high-performance dairy proteins that enable our partners to create exceptional products.

Our work sits at the intersection of molecular biology, food science, and industrial biotechnology. By combining cutting-edge science with deep application expertise, we empower the dairy industry to deliver products that are indulgent, functional, and more sustainable - without compromise.

Formo is a venture-backed, fast-growing company with an international team of entrepreneurs, scientists, and operators united by the ambition to transform dairy from within the industry. Together with our partners, we are shaping a future where animal-free dairy proteins unlock new possibilities for innovation at global scale.


Key Responsibilities

Analytical Testing

  • Perform routine HPLC-UV analyses according to established SOPs

  • Conduct protein assays (e.g. Bradford) and support physicochemical analyses (e.g. particle size determination)

Sample Preparation

  • Prepare samples for proteomics analyses (e.g. protein extraction, digestion, purification)

Documentation & Quality

  • Thoroughly evaluate and document results in accordance with internal guidelines

Instrument Management

  • Operate, clean, calibrate and maintain analytical instruments

Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Work closely with scientists to support ongoing projects


About You

Education & Experience

  • Completed training as a BTA, CTA or comparable qualification

  • Initial practical laboratory experience (e.g. through training, internships or entry-level work)

Technical & Functional Skills

  • Basic knowledge of HPLC or chromatographic methods is a plus

  • Good documentation skills

  • English proficiency at least B1 level (spoken and written); German is a plus

Mindset & Collaboration 

  • Careful, structured and reliable working style, with high motivation and scientific curiosity to learn new techniques

  • Genuine interest in protein analytics and biochemical methods

  • Team-oriented mindset with a strong sense of responsibility


Why you’ll love it here

Ready to shake things up?

At Formo, you don’t just trade your labor for compensation - you join a mission. One powered by frontier science, real-world impact, and a team of brilliant, driven people who care deeply about what they’re building.

You’ll work side by side with interdisciplinary experts across highly skilled entrepreneurs, scientists, and operators. We believe the best ideas emerge when diverse perspectives collide, and when people are trusted with responsibility, autonomy, and meaningful challenges.

We’re building something ambitious, and we take the work seriously - but not ourselves. Expect close collaboration, fast learning and innovation, and a culture that celebrates progress (often with tastings 🧀).


What we offer:

  • Help reinvent one of the world’s most iconic food categories

  • Participate in employee equity and build long-term ownership in what we’re creating

  • Benefit from regular team off-sites, monthly perks like discounted public transport passes and fitness memberships

  • Invest in your growth with a dedicated annual development budget for learning, training, and conferences

  • Connect over regular team lunches, healthy and not so healthy snacks and drinks and shared moments that bring the team together

Trusted by thousands of organizations globally, Leapsome secured $60 million in Series A funding led by Insight Partners in March 2022. This funding allowed us to further develop our intelligent platform, create exceptional employee experiences, and expand into the US market.

It’s an incredibly exciting time to join Leapsome and be part of reshaping the future of work!

Your Opportunity

We're building the SDR function at Leapsome from the ground up, and you'd be the third person on the team. That's a different job than joining an established sales org. There's no thick playbook waiting for you to follow. You'll help write it: what messaging works, which accounts to prioritize, what a good week actually looks like. If you want ownership over your process instead of a script to read from, this is built for you.

Our philosophy: we're AI forward. Automations handle the repetitive parts of prospecting, so you're not spending your day on manual busywork. Your job is to test what's actually working and add the human spark; the right tone, the right timing, the read on what a real person needs to hear.


Day to day, you'll research and reach out to HR and People leaders who could genuinely benefit from Leapsome, qualify them, and hand off strong opportunities to our AEs. We measure success in pipeline generated and meetings booked, and we're transparent about the career opportunities to grow your sales profession.

  • Hybrid and flexible work: Spend 2 days a week with the team in our Berlin office, Tuesdays and Thursdays.

Arbeitsort
