Deine Aufgaben

Your Mission
Bei Conceptboard bauen wir ein Kollaborationsprodukt, auf das Enterprise-Kunden, öffentliche Institutionen und sicherheitskritische Organisationen täglich vertrauen. Damit die Teams, die dieses Produkt entwickeln, jederzeit auf voller Geschwindigkeit liefern können, brauchen sie eine Plattform, die ihnen aus dem Weg geht – nicht eine, die sie ausbremst.

Als Platform Architect / Staff Engineer bist du Eigentümer der Core Platform Architecture – und du baust sie selbst, hands-on. Dein Design-Constraint Nummer eins: Die Plattform ist nie der Bottleneck. Du denkst in Self-Service-Capabilities, sauberen Contracts und klaren Boundaries – und du machst das Platform-Team zum Agentic-Engineering-Lighthouse der gesamten Organisation. Das hier ist keine Ivory-Tower-Rolle: Du setzt Richtung, indem du sie shippst.

Your Responsibilities

  • Target Architecture ownen. Du formulierst, validierst und entwickelst die Architecture der Core Platform – inklusive der make-or-break Entscheidungen dahinter. Du bist die primäre Ansprechperson für Architektur-Ownership auf Platform-Ebene und entlastest damit die bestehende Architektur-Verantwortung von einer einzelnen Person.
  • Hands-on bauen. Du leitest und trägst persönlich zum Proof-of-Concept bei, der die kritischen Hypothesen validiert – und danach zu den Platform Services selbst. Du bist Builder, nicht nur Designer.
  • Platform as a Product. Du designst Services als Self-Service-Capabilities, die Module-Teams unblocked halten. Thinnest viable Platform beats Gold-Plating, immer.
  • Contracts & Standards setzen und schützen. Du definierst und sicherst die Contracts zwischen Plattform und Module-Teams: APIs, Boundaries, Non-Functional Requirements – und sorgst dafür, dass sie eingehalten werden.
  • Agentic-First von Tag eins. Du etablierst disziplinierte Agentic-Engineering-Practices im Platform-Team und machst es zur Referenz für die gesamte Engineering-Organisation.
  • Lead by Example. Du inspirierst dein Team mit einem Platform-First-Mindset. Deine Teammitglieder wachsen, weil sie dir zuschauen – und weil du die Standards, die du setzt, selbst lebst.
  • Alignment mit dem Architect. Du arbeitest eng mit dem bestehenden Architect zusammen, um übergreifende Architektur-Entscheidungen abzustimmen und zu validieren.


Dein Profil

Must-haves

  • Hands-on Builder mit starkem Track Record. Du hast Plattformen oder Services at scale architektiert und gebaut – und du codest noch. Kein reiner Architecture-by-PowerPoint-Hintergrund.
  • Platform-as-a-Product-Instinct. Du hast Self-Service-Plattformen gebaut, die andere Teams schneller gemacht haben. Du weißt, wie Plattformen zum Bottleneck werden – und designst aktiv dagegen. Interne Teams sind für dich echte Kunden.
  • Sound Engineering Practices. Testing, Contracts, Observability, CI/CD, klare Boundaries – und das Urteilsvermögen, welche Non-Functional Requirements tatsächlich zählen.
  • Genuine Motivation für Agentic Engineering. Du willst Agentic-First mit Disziplin bauen, nicht mit Hype – und du willst es für andere modellieren.
Strongly preferred
  • Erfahrung in regulierten Umgebungen mit hohen Compliance-Anforderungen.
  • Relevante Domain-Tiefe für eine Collaboration-Plattform, z. B. Distributed Systems oder Real-Time-Architektur.
  • Erfahrung mit Agentic-First-Workflows – privat oder professionell.


Das erwartet dich bei uns

  • Flexibilität – Genieße umfassende Freiheit bezüglich deines Arbeitsortes und gestalte deine Arbeitszeiten ganz nach deinen Bedürfnissen.
  • Eigenverantwortung – Bei uns hast du die Möglichkeit, selbstständig und eigenverantwortlich zu arbeiten, unterstützt von einer flachen Hierarchie und kurzen Entscheidungswegen.
  • Internationalität – wir arbeiten in einem globalen Team, das kulturelle Vielfalt schätzt und fördert. Unser internationales Netzwerk ermöglicht es dir, weltweit Kontakte zu knüpfen.
  • Zusammenhalt – Wir wissen, wie wichtig persönliche Treffen sind, um den Teamgeist zu stärken. Daher organisieren wir regelmäßig Social Events.
  • Wettbewerbsfähige Vergütung – Du erhältst ein attraktives Gehaltspaket und 30 Tage Urlaub pro Jahr.
  • Mitarbeitervorteile – Nutze eine Vielzahl von Vergünstigungen über unseren externen Corporate Benefits Partner.

jobs.description:
An opportunity to help patients who have run out of options

For many people living with chronic pain, the journey has been long. They have tried multiple medications, procedures and therapies, yet their pain continues to impact every aspect of daily life. By the time they reach us, many are looking for another option where conventional treatment has fallen short.

We are Montu UK, one of the UK's largest medical cannabis clinics, and we are looking for Consultants specialising in Pain Management to join our clinical team.

 

About the role

You will assess and manage patients exploring cannabis based medicines, making the clinical decision on whether treatment is appropriate and managing their care from there. This is an evolving area of medicine where the evidence base continues to grow, giving you the opportunity to help shape how cannabis based medicines are used within pain management in the UK.

You do not need previous experience with cannabis based medicines. We are looking for experienced Pain Management Consultants with sound clinical judgement, an open mind and a genuine interest in improving outcomes for patients with complex chronic pain. We provide comprehensive specialist training, and our multidisciplinary model means you are never working in isolation. Nurses and pharmacists complete pre consultation and follow up prescribing tasks, allowing you to focus on clinical decision making and patient care.

 

What you will be doing:

  • Provide high quality care for patients seeking medical cannabis treatment.

  • Conduct patient consultations, including assessment and ongoing management.

  • Engage in clinical outcome data collection to support evidence based practices.

  • Contribute to clinical governance and maintain robust patient care standards.

  • Collaborate effectively within a multidisciplinary team, including nurses and pharmacists.

  • Participate in ongoing training and professional development, including bespoke specialist training in cannabis based medicines (CBMPs).

 

What you need:

  • Full GMC Registration

  • Completion of Specialist Training (CCST/CCT) or equivalent certification

  • On the GMC Specialist Register for Pain

  • Demonstrated interest in alternative therapies

  • Willingness to participate in data collection and reporting

 

Why join us?

  • Highly Competitive Salary: £190,000 - £275,000 FTE, pro rata for part time roles

  • Flexible Working: Full time or part time options available

  • Comprehensive Indemnity Coverage: Montu will cover all professional and clinical indemnity insurance for your work with us

  • Private Healthcare

  • Work-Life Balance: No night shifts or on call requirements

  • Cutting Edge Training: Access to CPD accredited medical cannabis education and specialist in house training from industry leaders

  • Collaborative Environment: Join a multidisciplinary team of healthcare professionals

  • Personal Growth: Be part of a pioneering field and shape the future of medical cannabis care in the UK

Training & Development:

  • Attendance at a recognised Medical Cannabis Course for Specialist Physicians (sponsored by Montu)

  • Specialist training delivered by experts, including Prof Anup Mathew (Consultant Psychiatrist) and Dr Gerard Sinovich (Pain Management Consultant).

  • Ongoing support and training on clinical protocols, prescribing practices, and Montu’s system usage

Working arrangements:

  • Remote Role: Flexible working hours and days

  • Session Structure:

  • Standard session length: 4 hours

  • Appointment duration: 15 minutes (new and existing patients)

 

Montu’s multidisciplinary model allows consultants to focus on prescribing and patient care, while nurses and pharmacists handle pre consultation and follow up tasks.

If you are passionate about innovative patient care, thrive in a dynamic environment, and are looking to make a real impact in the field of medical cannabis, we would love to hear from you!

 

Sessions:

Each standard session consists of 4 hours of patient consultations. Clinicians can choose their preferred working days and hours, with sessions spread flexibly if needed.

To support onboarding, clinicians are required to commit to a minimum of 2 sessions per week/ 8 hours initially, to ensure they become proficient with Montu’s platform.

 

Appointment Durations:

Appointments are 15 minutes in length for new and existing patients as Montu operates a multidisciplinary approach, leveraging a clinical skills mix where nurses and pharmacists handle pre-consultation and follow-up prescribing tasks allowing Consultants to focus on prescribing and patient care.

 

About MONTU

Montu UK is a leading digital health company specialising in cannabis based medicines (CBPM). We are committed to transforming lives by improving access to safe, effective treatments and offering an exceptional standard of care. Our dynamic and supportive work environment is the perfect place for you to grow professionally while making a meaningful impact on patients’ lives.

jobs.title: Director, Mobility Partnerships
jobs.description:
Material Bank is the world's largest material marketplace for the architecture and design industry. Operating in 37 countries, our platform has become the standard for design professionals around the globe. Every day, Material Bank connects thousands of designers with tens of thousands of materials from leading brands. Material Bank is the fastest and most powerful way for design professionals to search, sample, and specify materials.

As Director, Mobility Partnerships, you will lead Material Bank's expansion into the global mobility interiors market, building strategic partnerships with leading brands across automotive, aviation, and marine. This is not a traditional sales role—it is an opportunity to establish a new vertical by leveraging deep industry expertise, trusted relationships, and commercial acumen.

You will be responsible for identifying, engaging, and securing founding brand partners while serving as Material Bank's representative within a highly specialized industry. Success in this role requires credibility, confidence, and the ability to build long-term relationships with senior leaders across Europe and North America. You understand the business, speak the language of the industry, and know how to create value beyond the transaction.

This is a senior, external-facing role for someone who has spent their career within the mobility interiors ecosystem. You thrive in face-to-face conversations, industry events, customer visits, and executive meetings, knowing that lasting partnerships are built through trust and personal relationships. The role is Europe-based and requires extensive international travel (approximately 80–90%) across Europe and North America, with significant focus on Germany, Switzerland, and the Netherlands.

What you'll do

  • Build Material Bank's founding portfolio of mobility interior brand partners across automotive, aviation, and marine.
  • Own the full business development lifecycle, from identifying opportunities and developing relationships through negotiation and partnership execution.
  • Represent Material Bank at industry trade shows, conferences, and customer events, building awareness and establishing credibility within the mobility interiors community.
  • Develop trusted relationships with executives, commercial leaders, designers, specification teams, and decision-makers across leading manufacturers and suppliers.
  • Lead consultative business conversations that demonstrate how Material Bank creates value through material discovery, digital sampling, specification tools, and market insights.
  • Partner closely with Product, Catalog, Marketing, and Leadership to shape Material Bank's strategy for the mobility sector, bringing customer and market insights back into the business.
  • Identify market opportunities, competitive trends, and emerging technologies that influence the future of mobility interiors.
  • Serve as a trusted industry expert, helping establish Material Bank as the leading platform for mobility material discovery.

What you'll bring

  • 15+ years of experience within the mobility interiors industry, ideally in automotive, aviation, marine, or a related materials manufacturing environment.
  • Deep knowledge of the European mobility market, with an established network of manufacturers, suppliers, OEMs, and industry leaders.
  • A proven ability to build trusted relationships and influence senior executives through credibility, expertise, and a consultative approach.
  • Strong commercial instincts with experience developing new business and closing strategic partnerships.
  • An entrepreneurial mindset with the ability to build a business, create opportunities, and operate effectively with a high degree of autonomy.
  • Exceptional communication skills and executive presence, with confidence engaging customers, partners, and industry leaders.
  • Experience representing organizations at industry events and trade shows.
  • Highly self-motivated, resourceful, and comfortable operating in a fast-paced, evolving environment.
  • Willingness to travel extensively (approximately 75%) throughout Europe and North America.
  • A passion for innovation and the future of mobility design.

Material Bank connects design professionals to hundreds of manufacturers through facilitating brand discovery, sales rep engagement, and material sampling. Our powerful material database and proprietary robotic distribution facility allow members to order samples to be delivered free of charge overnight.Material Bank was founded by Adam Sandow in 2018 and has deeply transformed how the Architecture and Design industry works in the United States. It's an exciting time for the company - Material Bank is growing rapidly and expanding the business to Europe with regional headquarters based in Paris, and offices in London and Stuttgart. Candidates who join us will have the unique opportunity to define, build, and shape our European business.

Material Bank uses your information to process your current application and offer you job opportunities in the future. You have the right to access, rectify, and erase this information, as well as to limit its use or object to it and give directives on its fate after your death. For more information, please consult our privacy policy: https://www.materialbank.eu/privacy-policy

 

What you'll get from us:

  • Our people: We are a growth-driven team that values efficiency, builds smart automation, operates in small empowered teams, and moves quickly from idea to execution.
  • Relaxation and Celebrations: Flexible PTO, Sick Days, Paid National Holidays, and even more (ask us about this when we connect). 
  • Health Benefits: We contribute to your medical, dental, vision and short-term/long-term disability plans and have a strong employee assistance program. 
  • Plan for your Retirement: 401(k) eligible after your first 90 day's employed!
  • Giving Back: We sponsor multiple events throughout the year to help out our communities. 
  • Growth: We'll help you take your career to the next level. We want you to be creative and take initiative which will allow you to grow and create within the company. Most importantly, be the best at what matters! 
  • Flexible Work Schedules: With business units and employees across the globe, Material Technologies has embraced a hybrid  working model allowing department leaders to decide on the best approach for their respective teams, whether that be remote, in person, or a little of both.  

Material Bank is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We value diversity, and all applicants will be considered for employment without attention to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, national origin, veteran or disability status or other status protected under any applicable federal, state or local law.

jobs.description:
Über uns:

Wir verstehen die Halbleiterindustrie als ein Universum voller Möglichkeiten. Wir erkennen Chancen und sehen das transformative Potenzial, das unsere Graphen-Lösungen für die Neugestaltung der Branche mit sich bringen.

Wir laden Sie ein, diesen Wandel gemeinsam mit uns voranzutreiben, indem wir kluge Köpfe mit einer gemeinsamen Vision zusammenbringen. Diese Vision ist es, zu zeigen, dass grundlegende Veränderungen möglich sind. Mit Ihrem Wissen und Ihren Fähigkeiten können Sie beweisen, dass Dinge anders – und besser – gemacht werden können.

Gemeinsam haben wir die Kraft, das Paradigma zu verändern, wie die Welt vernetzt ist.

Unsere Technology:

Die steigenden Anforderungen der Halbleiterindustrie an leistungsfähigere Chips mit höherer Bandbreite und geringerem Energieverbrauch werden durch unsere Technologie adressiert. Wir ermöglichen die Verbindung von Chips mit Hochdurchsatz-Computernetzwerken bei minimaler Latenz.

Der entscheidende Faktor ist die Nutzung der einzigartigen physikalischen Eigenschaften von Graphen, um elektronische Datenverarbeitung mit photonischer Kommunikation zu vereinen. Dadurch können unzählige Chips miteinander interagieren, als wären sie ein einziges System. Unsere Graphen-Photonik-Innovation hebt Rechenleistung und Effizienz auf ein neues Niveau.

Kurz gesagt: Wir vernetzen Chips zu leistungsstarken, energieeffizienten Systemen und überwinden mit unserer Graphen-Technologie die bisherigen Grenzen der Konnektivität in der Halbleiterindustrie.

Die Rolle

Als Senior General Ledger Accountant & Closing Specialist (DE/NL) (w/m/d) übernehmen Sie eine zentrale Rolle in unserem Finance-Team. Sie sorgen für einen reibungslosen Closing-Prozess, stellen die Qualität unserer Finanzbuchhaltung sicher und tragen gleichzeitig dazu bei, unsere Finance-Organisation für weiteres internationales Wachstum aufzustellen.

Dabei verbinden Sie operative Exzellenz mit dem Blick für das große Ganze. Gemeinsam mit unserem Finance-Team entwickeln Sie Prozesse weiter, schaffen belastbare Strukturen und bringen Ihre Erfahrung aktiv in den Aufbau einer skalierbaren internationalen Finanzorganisation ein.

Das sollte Sie begeistern

  • Verantwortung für die Hauptbuchhaltung sowie die Erstellung von Monats-, Quartals- und Jahresabschlüssen

  • Aktive Mitarbeit im operativen Tagesgeschäft, einschließlich Buchungen, Kontenabstimmungen und Qualitätssicherung

  • Unterstützung bei der kontinuierlichen Weiterentwicklung unserer Finance-Prozesse und -Strukturen

  • Mitwirkung beim Aufbau skalierbarer internationaler Finanzstrukturen, insbesondere im Umfeld unserer deutschen und niederländischen Gesellschaften

  • Sicherstellung und kontinuierliche Weiterentwicklung einer transparenten und belastbaren Finance-Dokumentation

  • Optimierung und Standardisierung von Accounting- und Closing-Prozessen sowie Unterstützung des Monthly Reportings

  • Mitarbeit bei Intercompany-Themen und der Weiterentwicklung gruppenweiter Abstimmungsprozesse zwischen Deutschland und den Niederlanden

  • Identifikation und Umsetzung von Effizienzpotenzialen sowie aktive Mitgestaltung von Digitalisierungs- und Automatisierungsinitiativen

jobs.title: Structured Finance Manager (m/f/d)
jobs.description:
At Credibur, we are building the infrastructure layer for European private credit: an operating system for non-bank lending that handles borrowing base calculations, drawdown automation, SPV oversight, covenant monitoring, reporting, and backup servicing. Our clients are originators and institutional capital providers across BNPL, factoring, SME lending, leasing, and auto receivables.

If you have spent the last few years inside one lender, one fund, or one asset class, this role offers something different. At Credibur you work across the full spectrum of European structured credit: multiple originators, multiple capital providers, multiple asset classes, simultaneously. Within your first year, you will have touched more deal structures and facility types than most structured finance professionals encounter in five years on a single originator's treasury team.

We are looking for a Structured Finance Manager (m/f/d) to own facility operations across our client base and be the primary day-to-day interface between originators and their lenders. You will work directly with the founding team on live deals from day one.

Tasks

  • Own borrowing base calculation logic: Translate facility documentation into calculation configurations on the Credibur platform: eligibility criteria, advance rates, concentration limits, exception handling. Once live, the platform executes automatically; your job is to design it correctly upfront and manage it as deals evolve.
  • Design asset tape schemas: Define the data requirements for each new client onboarding: which fields matter for the asset class, how originator data maps to Credibur's platform, and where the gaps are. Once configured, ingestion runs automatically; you own the schema design and its ongoing integrity as deals and data sources evolve.
  • Maintain backup servicing playbooks: Define and document operational runbooks for each backup servicing mandate. No prior backup servicing experience required; we will train. What matters is being structured and thorough enough to document processes clearly.
  • Shape the product: Work closely with our engineering team to translate what you see on deals into platform improvements. You are the closest person to how clients actually use Credibur in practice; your input directly drives what gets built.
  • Manage client operations: Handle day-to-day queries from originator treasury teams and lender portfolio managers. Flag issues early, own resolution where you can, and know when to loop in the right people.

Requirements

  • 3 to 4 years of experience in structured finance, warehouse lending, or capital markets operations at a non-bank lender, asset manager, or credit servicer
  • Direct, personal responsibility for producing reports or calculations for an institutional counterparty (not advisory, not purely modeling)
  • Exposure to borrowing base mechanics, eligibility criteria, and asset tape workflows
  • Asset class experience in consumer lending, BNPL, SME loans, factoring, or auto receivables
  • Strong English; able to handle a professional client call independently
  • Nice to have: German language skills (significant plus given our client base); other European languages are a bonus
  • Nice to have: Berlin-based or willing to relocate. Remote candidates from within Europe are possible but Berlin is strongly preferred at this stage.

What We Offer

Unmatched deal breadth at an early career stage

You see how different originators run their facilities, how different lenders and funds approach monitoring and reporting, and how the same mechanics play out differently across asset classes. That breadth is difficult to build anywhere else at this stage.

Direct access to live deals and institutional counterparties

You are not a junior analyst sitting behind a senior relationship manager. You are the operational contact for Heads of Treasury at originators and Lead Portfolio Managers at credit funds.

Founding team proximity

Credibur is early. You work directly alongside the founders on deals that are live and consequential. What you build here shapes how the company operates for years.

Setup

Berlin-based or remote within Europe or UK with travel every few months to our Berlin HQ and/or to clients. No visa sponsorship available.

At Credibur, we believe that diverse teams build better products. We welcome applications from people of all backgrounds, regardless of gender, age, ethnicity, disability, sexual orientation, or religion. If you're passionate about what we do but don't meet 100% of the criteria, we still encourage you to apply. We value potential and ambition.

All hires complete on-site onboarding in Berlin. Background checks are required as part of our standard compliance process.

About Spire:

Spire Global is a leading provider of space-based data, analytics, and services, helping organizations make better decisions with insights from our constellation of satellites. We are committed to operational excellence, compliance, and maintaining the highest standards of internal control.

As a Senior Systems Engineer, you will be responsible for the technical outcome of complex space missions. During mission contracting and requirements development, you may work with the sales engineering org to ensure mission requirements are valid and mission scope is adequately defined. Systems Engineers translate higher level requirements down to lower-level requirements, consulting and collaborating with discipline team-leads and subject matter experts where necessary.  

You will be the overall technical lead responsible for "building the right thing" and "building it right". This will include the management of system requirements, technical budgets, and sub-system interfaces.  Your responsibility extends to ensuring there is sufficient verification and testing of the system, and you will take ownership of the technical performance outcomes for the mission. You will be the mission's technical lead for both Spire-internal and external (customer, contractor, etc) teams, working collaboratively with others to resolve technical discrepancies in requirements, specifications, or system performance. 

You will also act as the technical point of contact for Spire's global customers during mission development phases and through on-orbit validation of the space systems, working with Spire project and program managers to provide effective communication where required. 

Your knowledge and experience working across multiple technical disciplines will help you coordinate Spire's technical efforts to ensure ultimate mission success. 

Role Responsibilities:

  • Take overall technical ownership of Spire Space and/or Ground Systems from technical development through on-orbit verification; ensure that we are "building the right thing" and "building it right".
  • Lead requirements management for a given mission or program - including development, validation, verification, and change management.
  • Lead technical risk management for a given mission or program - including identification, qualification, mitigation, and resolution.
  • Develop top-level requirements and then flow-down to lower-levels, consulting and collaborating with discipline team-leads and subject matter experts where necessary.
  • Serve as the primary Spire technical POC to customers and contractors - communicating and advocating on behalf of internal technical teams where necessary.
  • Serve as the customer's technical representative to Spire-internal teams - communicating and sometimes advocating for customer requirements, expectations, and experiences.
  • Develop working knowledge of Spire's satellite platforms, operations systems, and payloads (both Spire and customer-developed) - including customer APIs and software service interfaces.
  • Proactively communicate to program/project managers where changes in scope, requirements, expected system performance, or development outcomes impact the mission.
  • Develop, deliver, and maintain mission documentation required to support programs or missions, including both internal and external (customer- or contractor-facing) documentation.
  • Support the sales engineering team in the development of technical concepts and budgets, feasibility assessments, requirements, scope, and documentation needed during the sales cycle.

Basic Qualifications:

  • BSc in Engineering, Computer Science, equivalent STEM-related subject, or equivalent work experience.
  • 5+ years of experience working in a technical engineering discipline (Mechanical, Electrical, Software, Controls, RF Communications, etc) or as a systems engineer for complex integrated systems.
  • Comprehensive understanding of space systems, concepts of operations, and remote systems operation.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • 3+ years of experience as a space systems engineer working across engineering disciplines (Mechanical, Electrical, Software, Controls, Radio/Comms, etc)
  • Experience developing or integrating RF and optical payloads.
  • Experience participating in architecture and design of digital systems including ground station networks, data distribution and data processing systems, and spacecraft data handling systems
  • Experience coordinating or leading diverse technical teams spanning multiple engineering disciplines and time zones
  • Strong interpersonal skills for building relationships with clients and effectively communicating with other members of cross-functional teams
  • Strong comprehension skills to enable timely understanding of complex customer requirements and identification of thorough and sometimes unique solutions
  • Experience in satellite mission design, development, and testing with a clear understanding of major mission design trades and scope drivers (power / payload duty cycle, communications systems / data budgets, ground stations, launch and environmental loads, EMI/EMC, thermal management, etc.)

Spire operates a hybrid work model, and this position will require you to work a minimum of three days per week in the office.

Access to US export-controlled software and/or technology may be required for this role. If needed, Spire will arrange the necessary licenses—this is not something candidates need to have before applying. #LI-MK1

 


Global Perks

🛰️ Name Your Satellite Program (NYSP)
🚀 Launch Attendance
🌴 Generous Time Off Policy
🎓 Education Assistance Program
🥰 Employee Assistance Program (EAP)
📈 Employee Stock Purchase Program (ESPP)
👣 Family Leave
💪 Fitness Reimbursement
🧡 Employee Referral Program
🍉 Healthy snacks & beverages in every office

 

About Spire

We improve life on Earth with data from space.

Spire Global is a space-to-cloud analytics company that owns and operates the largest multi-purpose constellation of satellites. Its proprietary data and algorithms provide the most advanced maritime, aviation, and weather tracking in the world. In addition to its constellation, Spire's data infrastructure includes a global ground station network and 24/7 operations that provide real-time global coverage of every point on Earth.
